TITLE: Step 2: Explore the Digital Product
INTRO: Explore the digital product to understand its purpose, functionality, and use. This step helps you determine which views to use for the evaluation in the next steps. Identify the web technologies used to provide the website and, if you want, take notes on other aspects of the website. Usually it's best to get input from the website owners and developers for this step.
RESOURCE_LINK_NAME: Step 2: Explore the Target Digital Product
INF_RELIEDUP_TECH: Identify the technologies [relied upon according to WCAG 2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-relied-upon) to provide the website. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 2.d: Identify Technologies Relied Upon](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step2d).
INF_NOTE_TAKING: This section lets you record information during your exploration of the digital product. The notes in the next step help you select a sample of web pages for evaluation. **These notes are not included in the final report.** They are saved with the file and are available when you reopen it.
LABEL_ESSENT_FUNC: Essential functionality of the digital product
INF_ESSENT_FUNC:
You can use this field to take notes about essential functionality of the digital product. Examples of essential functionality include:
‘selecting and purchasing a product from the shop area of the website’
‘completing and submitting a form provided on the website’
‘registering for an account on the website’
For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 2.b: Identify Essential Functionality of the Digital Product](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step2b).
INF_VARIETY_PAGE_TYPES:
You can use this field to take notes about the types (as opposed to instances) of views that you find in the digital product. This includes notes about different styles, layouts, structures, and functionality provided in the digital product. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 2.3: Identify the variety of sample types](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step2c).
**Note**: ‘Samples’ includes all different states within a sample; see the principle of [product enclosure](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/#principle-of-product-enclosure).
